title: Notice of NIDCR Pre-Application Webinar and FAQs for Community-Based Participatory Research Initiative (PAR-27-015 and RFA-DE-27-001)
issuing_orgs: National Institute of Dental and Craniofacial Research
purpose_tldr: NIDCR announces a pre-application informational webinar on Wednesday June 24, 2026 (2-3 PM ET) for two upcoming oral-health NOFOs: PAR-27-015 (Community-Based Participatory Research, UG3/UH3) and RFA-DE-27-001 (CEED Hub, U01). FAQs and slides will be posted before and after the webinar.
eligibility_tldr: This is an announcement, not a funding opportunity itself. Anyone planning to apply to PAR-27-015 or RFA-DE-27-001 is invited; pre-registration is required and webinar attendance is optional.
dos: Pre-register for the June 24, 2026 webinar via the NIDCR registration link
Submit questions at least 5 business days in advance to the program contact
Read the FAQs before the webinar and check back for updates
Watch for the recorded slides and recording posted 7-10 business days after
donts: Do not assume the webinar substitutes for reading the NOFOs themselves
Do not skip pre-registration; it is required even though attendance is optional
strategic_priorities: Community-based participatory research in oral health
